checkedAlternates.risk: Stamping can punch holes out of sheet metal.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Sheet metal stamping is a press-forming process (group-4), distinct from chip-removing CNC/lathe/grinding machining (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: SLA cures liquid photopolymer in a vat.
checkedAlternates.resolution: SLA builds parts layer-by-layer without a solid mold, classifying it as additive manufacturing (group-1).
